# Multispectral Mixed Resolution Small

A tiny three-band uint16 multispectral stack combining native 10 m and 20 m bands resampled onto a common 10 m grid. Documents the mixed-resolution delivery pattern in a single GeoTIFF.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Case ID | `multispectral_mixed_resolution_small` |
| Category | raster |
| Format | GeoTIFF |
| CRS | `EPSG:32633` |
| Test tier | integration |
| Size class | tiny |
| Storage class | bundled |
| Redistributable | yes |
| Loader | `rasterio` |
| Status | validated |

## Use this case

```python
import pytest


@pytest.mark.geocase_case("multispectral_mixed_resolution_small")
def test_multispectral_mixed_resolution_small(geocase_case) -> None:
    data = geocase_case.load()
    assert data is not None
```

## What this case checks

Confirm GeoCase preserves a multispectral stack assembled from bands of differing native resolutions resampled to a common grid.

## Risk types covered

- [`band_loss`](../../risk/band-loss.md)
- [`resampling_assumptions`](../../risk/resampling-assumptions.md)
- [`resolution_mismatch`](../../risk/resolution-mismatch.md)
